justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/Plugin.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/build/PluginFactoryUsingReflectionTest.java`. `Plugin.Ambiguous` is a small package-private nested helper with one constructor, two fields for the competing constructors, and only two operations (`replaceBy` and `instantiate`); it exists solely to represent and report constructor ambiguity inside `Resolved.replaceBy` (line 451). There is no evidence of many methods, multiple responsibilities, or low cohesion that would indicate insufficient modularization.
